charts.$description: The component tier: the tokens <ua-view> reads, as aliases into the common and base tiers. packages/dom lists the same names with the value each falls back to where a page loads no tokens (src/tokens.ts), and a test holds the two together.

color.$description: What a view paints with, under the names @automattic/charts gives its own colours (its prefix is --a8c-charts-). A series colour is three: the mark, text in its colour, and its tint. `background` is the surface a view stands on, for the halo behind a label; a surface that is not the page sets it for the views it holds.

label-inverse.$description: Text on the tooltip surface. Black in both themes, as the surface is one colour in both.

tooltip-surface.$description: The readout and the crosshair's words: the marker colour, from the constants, so it is the same in both themes.

tooltip-surface-secondary.$description: The crosshair's word for a comparison: quieter than the surface, edged in it, and the same in both themes.

tooltip-border.$description: The stroke about the readout and the words of a crosshair. Black in both themes, as their text is.

label-screen.$description: The lit cells of a number in dots, and at a tenth of it the unlit ones: the lime ramp's last step in both themes.

border-radius.$description: Corners. `bar` and `cell` are @automattic/charts' names; a legend's swatch and the readout have their own.

stroke-width.$description: A line of the data where its layer gives no width, a rule or a grid line, and the outline of whatever has the reader's attention: the holder with focus, and the mark chosen in it.

font-family.$description: The face of a view's axis labels and notes, and of its small numbers: Ans Mono, a pixel face, where the page has loaded it (fonts/ans-mono.css), and its numerals' cut after it for the signs that one has and it has not. The words a view is read by, a row's label and the prose, stay in the page's own face.

font-size.$description: The four faces of a view's text, and the smaller one its number takes where the larger does not fit. Ticks and small numbers are in a pixel face of eight pixels to the em. A tick is set at 8 px, a pixel to each of its own, and a small number at 12 px, a pixel and a half, which is whole device pixels on a screen of two to one. The rest are the fluid scale's steps, so a face follows the width of the view it is in.

font-optical-size.$description: How far apart the number's pixels are drawn: the optical size its face is set at, whatever its size. Ans Mono's runs from 8, where a pixel fills its cell, to 144.

motion.$description: What a data change is timed by. `entrance` is @automattic/charts' own; a node that moves and one that leaves have theirs. `delay-tooltip` is how long the readout waits over a row that already says its value. `duration-roll` is one character of a number in dots rolling to the next, in eight steps. `duration-draw` is a line drawing in when its plot first shows.

elevation.$description: How far a thing stands from the view, as a box-shadow: the readout and the words of a crosshair above it.
